La raison de sa création n'est pas d'étudier la connaissance universelle, mais de propager des stratégies de guerre impitoyables et d'asseoir la loi du plus fort, propageant la folie sous couvert de sagesse.

source: Cỗ máy tự động được chế tạo bằng việc ghép nối với công nghệ còn sót lại của thế giới cũ, dùng để thay thế con người làm những việc đòi hỏi thể lực cơ bản nhất. Trong trận, cỗ máy tự động "Nhền Nhện" vô cùng không ổn định, rất dễ phát nổ khi bị hư hỏng.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology, tasked with replacing humans in performing the most basic forms of physical labor. In combat, Automaton Spiders are highly unstable, capable of exploding when damaged.

source: Cỗ máy tự động được chế tạo bằng việc ghép nối với công nghệ còn sót lại của thế giới cũ, robot hình người hiếm thấy với một chiếc máy cưa xích trên cánh tay phải, hình như từng dùng để thu hoạch hoặc xây dựng. Trong trận, cưa xích của cỗ máy tự động "Sói Nanh Nhọn" sẽ gây ra các vết rách, khiến đối thủ bị mất HP liên tục.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. This rare type of humanoid automaton is equipped with a chainsaw on its right arm, presumably used for mining or construction operations. In combat, Automaton Direwolfs will use their chainsaw to Bleed enemies, dealing DoT.

source: Cỗ máy tự động được chế tạo bằng việc ghép nối với công nghệ còn sót lại của thế giới cũ, trang bị thêm giáp hạng nặng để bảo vệ Thiết Vệ Bờm Bạc khi chiến đấu. Trong trận, cỗ máy tự động "Gấu Xám" sẽ phát ra tín hiệu để triệu hồi "Nhền Nhện" cùng hợp tác chiến đấu, đồng thời sẽ tích tụ động năng để tung đòn tấn công mạnh mẽ.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. It has been reinforced with durable armor, so it can charge forward and protect the Silvermane Guards. In combat, Automaton Grizzlys will summon Automaton Spiders and unleash a powerful charged attack.

source: Cỗ máy tự động được chế tạo bằng việc ghép nối với công nghệ còn sót lại của thế giới cũ, trên những chi phụ giữ vai trò di chuyển được gắn đèn tín hiệu, có vẻ như từng được dùng để thu hoạch hoặc xây dựng. Trong trận, cỗ máy tự động "Bọ Cánh Cứng" sẽ tạo ra một khiên lực trường để bảo vệ bản thân.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. A signal light is placed on its legs, and the unit may have been used for mining or construction operations. In combat, Automaton Beetles can create forcefields to shield themselves.

Dari bentuk dunia, hasrat untuk mencari kebenaran, serta ruang tak terbatas yang memberi mereka wujud, lahirlah kecerdasan dari segala kebijaksanaan. Ia bukan lagi boneka. Ia akan gugur dalam upacara pemakaman kesadaran dan meninggalkan sebuah nisan besi.
target: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

source: Dari kisah yang epik, legenda yang romantis, dan ribuan tahun yang memberi makna pada keduanya, lahirlah spiritualitas dari segala kepercayaan. Ia bukan lagi tahanan. Ia akan gugur dalam upacara pemakaman kesadaran dan meninggalkan sebuah nisan besi.
target: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

source: Das Bild des Eroberers, der einst mit absoluter Macht den Himmel beherrschte und nun von der Schwarzen Flut verschlungen wurde. Die Rechte und Pflichten seiner Vergangenheit mögen schwer zu beurteilen sein, aber in diesem Moment bleibt nur eine formlose Flamme karmischer Zerstörung, die vor mörderischer Absicht brodelt.
target: The image of the conqueror who once ruled the skies with absolute might, now consumed by the black tide. The rights and wrongs of their past may be difficult to judge, but at this moment, all that remains is a formless blaze of karmic destruction, seething with murderous intent.

source: Das Echo der Erinnerungen, die jemand einst an seine geliebte Familie hatte. In den langen Nächten sind sie mit ihm verbunden – in der Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft.
target: The echoes of the memories someone once held of their beloved family. Across the long night, they will accompany him in the past, present, and future.

source: Der Theoros, der im Namen von Lycurgus hunderte Millionen Zyklen schweigend beobachtete und den Willen von Zandar I Kuwabara, Mitglied Nr. 1 der Geniusgesellschaft, geerbt hat. Mit der Autorität des allerersten Genies gebietet er über eine Macht, die jene Legenden und Götter übertrifft – in dem Versuch, ein uraltes Experiment dem Schicksal der Zerstörung entgegenzuführen.
target: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member #1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

source: Der Unterboss des Synwish-Syndikats. Obwohl er auf Abwege geraten ist, hat er seinen Traum von der Musik nie aufgegeben und tanzt und singt sogar während der Kämpfe mit einem Instrument in der Hand.
target: The Underboss of the street gang, Synwish Syndicate. Though they've gone astray, their musical dreams never faded. They still sing and dance with instruments, even in combat.

source: Der Wächternachfolgerin von Belobog und Kommandantin der Silbermähnen-Wachen. Bronya kann verschiedene Taktiken gegen ihre Gegner einsetzen und die Kampffähigkeiten Verbündeter deutlich verstärken. Diese Erscheinung ist eine Illusion, die auf deinen Erinnerungen basiert.
target: Successor to Belobog's Guardian, and commander of the Silvermane Guards. Bronya can use various tactics to attack her enemies, and greatly enhance the battle prowess of friendly units. This entity is a phantom borne from your memories.

source: Der Zeit-Attentäter schleicht sich durch die Zeit und raubt allen rücksichtslos ihren wertvollen Aktionswert.
target: The Time Assassin weaves through time, ruthlessly harvesting everyone's precious action value.

source: Des corps qui ont continué à être rongés par le Fragmentum après leur mort. Bien que leurs signes vitaux aient été altérés, ils continuent à exécuter leurs ordres d'extermination. target: Bodies that continued to be corroded by the Fragmentum after death. While their vital signs have changed, they continue to carry out their orders to eliminate. Voidranger: Eliminators will mark enemies they hit, causing them to take extra damage when attacked.

source: Des fans aveuglés par leurs illusions, qui se battent uniquement pour Sparxie. Leur amour pour cette dernière et leur obsession pour la remise des diplômes se sont entremêlés, faisant d'eux une force à ne pas sous-estimer.
target: Fans who're controlled by illusions, fighting solely for Sparxie. Their love for Sparxie and obsession with graduation have become intertwined, making them a force not to be underestimated.

source: Diciptakan oleh sebagian dari pencerahan palsu "Asat Pramad", berusaha mendekonstruksi Elation sepenuhnya melalui analisis komedi. Keberadaannya terlahir demi menghancurkan keberadaan itu sendiri dengan menjadikan tragedi sebagai inti dari komedi, dan "Destruction" sebagai hakikat dari "Elation".
target: Born from a fragmented part of the Pseudo-Awakened One "Asat Pramad," it seeks to completely deconstruct the Elation by analyzing comedy. Its very existence exists for the sake of Destruction, taking tragedy as the core of comedy and "Destruction" as the ultimate truth of "Elation".

source: Die Aberration, die in der Künstlerschule entstanden ist, geht auf das Gerücht zurück, dass „die Pinsel von selbst malen“. Die Selbstvorwürfe der talentlosen Künstler, die Angst vor der Schule und die menschliche Faulheit haben sich gesammelt ... All das hat sich schließlich zu dieser Form entwickelt.
target: An aberration born in an art school, originating from the rumor of "brushes that move and paint on their own." It drew together the self-pity of talentless artists, their fear of attending school, and humanity's inherent laziness... ultimately becoming what it is today.

Die Aufgestiegene (Fehler)
Die Erinnerungen an den Zwist sind stets von Unnachgiebigkeit und Widerstand begleitet ...
target: Memories of Strife are always accompanied by defiance and resistance.

source: Die Gestalt der Welt, das Streben nach Erkenntnis und der grenzenlose Raum, der ihnen Form verleiht. Der Intellekt, aus dem alle Weisheit entspringt. Es ist keine Marionette mehr, es wird im Begräbnis des Geistenzials sterben und einen eisernen Grabstein hinterlassen.
target: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

source: Die Legende besagt, dass die plündernden Seesirenen singen können, um Seeleute mit schwachem Willen zu locken. Wer dem Wahnsinn verfällt, springt ins Meer und wird zur Delikatesse für die Tiefsee.
target: Legend has it that the plundering sea sirens can sing to lure sailors with wavering wills. Those who fall into madness will leap into the ocean and become a delicacy for the deep sea.

source: Die Schauspieler der Truppe der Wunschträume haben die Gnade der Ordnung erhalten und sind zu Marionetten geworden, die das Gesetz verkünden. Sie tanzen unter den obersten Geboten und präsentieren eine Aufführung zur Begrüßung des Paradieses.
target: The actors of the Sweet Dreams Troupe have accepted the grace of the Order and become puppets that declare the law. They dance under the supreme commandments, beginning a show that will welcome the coming of paradise.

source: Die Spitze seiner Lanze definiert grenzenlose Grenzen. Die Armeen und Völker inmitten der Grenzen wurden alle bezwungen oder werden es noch. The blood of the fearful will become honey for the divine body, and the souls of the defiant will walk into the palace of glory under the River of Souls.

target: In order to survive, some Underworlders are desperate enough to venture deep into the Fragmentum in search of anything salvageable. Ancient machinery that they dug up has become their best helper.

target: The twin sprites roaming the wilds and alleys of Amphoreus, taking pleasure in stealing valuables and playing tricks on travelers. They often outpace Treasure Hunters at the last moment, leaving only a coin as a harmless joke.

source: Die geniale Erfindung eines Handwerkers der Kunsthandwerkskommission. Ursprünglich handelte es sich um eine leblose Alarmglocke für Warnsignale. Nun hat diese aber durch gewisse Anpassungen eine kurze „Lebensspanne“ erhalten.

source: Die inneren Dämonen provozieren, den mächtigen Geist verdrängen, das Aussehen verwandeln ... Der karminrote Mond wird eine gezielte Jagd je nach der Schwäche seines Wirts veranstalten. Ist Feixiao die Jägerin oder die Beute in dieser endlosen Verfolgung?

source: Die inneren Dämonen provozieren, den mächtigen Geist verdrängen, das Aussehen verwandeln ... Die Ausgeburt, die in Feixiao lauert, hat ihre Jagd auf sie begonnen. Am Ende dieser Verfolgungsjagd wird die Überlebende als „Merlinskralle“ durch die Welt wandeln.
target: Provoking the temptations within, usurping the powerful spirit, transforming in appearance... The abomination lurking inside Feixiao has begun its hunt for her. At the end of this stalking pursuit, the surviving party would obtain the right to walk the world as the Merlin's Claw.

Die legendären Dolos-Banditenzwillinge, in ihrer Kampfkraft und ihrer makellosen Teamarbeit unübertroffen. Selbst die mächtigsten Helden fielen durch ihre vier Fäuste. Schließlich triumphieren zwei Fäuste selten über vier.
target: The legendary Dolos Bandit Twins, unmatched in combat prowess and flawless teamwork. Even the mightiest heroes fell before their four fists. After all, two fists rarely triumph against four.

source: Die treuen Untergebenen des Teufelskönigs mit dem schwarzen Umhang. Sie haben einen Teil der Macht des Teufelskönigs geerbt und neigen zur Gewalt. Auf jedem Planeten gibt es Beweise für ihre Verbrechen.

source: Die ultimative Verkörperung von Macht. Wie die Energie aussieht, die sich dahinter sammelt, ist unbekannt. Der Antimaterie-Motor kann anderen Gegnern Energie verleihen und ihre Fähigkeiten verstärken.
target: The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown. The Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

source: Die „Erinnerung“ funktioniert ähnlich wie eine „Fotografie“. Vielleicht wird sie durch die Beseitigung von „Verfälschung“ verlässlich, vielleicht aber auch nicht.
target: "Memory" is similar to "photographs." Even though it appears to record "reality," it actually invades, alienates, and alters "reality." Perhaps removing the "distortion" will make it reliable, or perhaps not.

Als Reaktion auf die Wünsche des kollektiven Bewusstseins können die von ihm geleiteten Hymnen die Welt den Wünschen nach neu formen und neue Gesetze erschaffen. Jeder, der sich dies wünscht, wird zu der Quelle seiner Macht.
target: Dominicus, the wisher of the Harmonious Choir, is one of the many embodiments of Xipe the Harmony. Due to the interferences from the Order, his appearance is different from before. Materialized as the Hive Mind's response to wishes, the hymns he conducts can reshape the world and create new laws per the wishes, and all who made this wish will become the source of his power.

source: Dominicus ความปรารถนาทั้งมวลแห่ง "คณะนักร้องประสานเสียง" เป็นหนึ่งในร่างอวตารของ Xipe แห่ง "ประสาน" และเนื่องจากถูกรบกวนโดย "พร้อมเพรียง" จึงทำให้รูปลักษณ์แตกต่างไปจากเดิม เพื่อเป็นการตอบสนองต่อความปรารถนาของกลุ่มจิตสำนึก บทเพลงสรรเสริญที่เขาขับขาน จึงสามารถสร้างโลกและกฎเกณฑ์ขึ้นมาใหม่อีกครั้ง ตามความปรารถนานับพันนับหมื่น โดยผู้ที่เฝ้าอธิษฐานทุกคน ล้วนกลายเป็นแหล่งที่มาของพลังของเขา

Dua bandit legendaris Dolos yang ahli dalam seni bela diri dan sangat kompak. Banyak pahlawan tumbang di tangan mereka. Karena bagaimanapun juga, mereka bukan lawan yang mudah.
target: The legendary Dolos Bandit Twins, unmatched in combat prowess and flawless teamwork. Even the mightiest heroes fell before their four fists. After all, two fists rarely triumph against four.

source: Dulunya merupakan kerabat Titan yang dipahat dari "Pertikaian", yang diresapi dengan ichor emas Nikador. Merupakan ciptaan kuat yang dapat menampung jiwa Titan, tapi kini telah jatuh menjadi mesin yang hanya tahu membunuh.
target: Once a Titankin sculpted from "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They are mighty constructs capable of housing a Titan's soul. Today, they have degraded into nothing more than machines that know only slaughter.

source: Duo synergique : Cuirassé blanc
Duo synergique : Sentinelle obscure liée par le sang
Dupla Sinergia: Duelista Sanguinário Sombrio
Dupla Sinergia: Vanguarda Branca Blindada

Durch NeiKos496s endlose Berechnungen nährt der Hass die Zerstörung, die das Sternenmeer zum Schweigen bringt. Dieses Gefühl quillt aus einer makellosen Hülle hervor und hinterlässt Echos von höchster Bosheit.
target: Through NeiKos496's endless extrapolations, "Hatred" nourishes "the Destruction" that silences the starry sea. This emotion overflows from a flawless shell, leaving behind echoes of supreme malevolence.

source: Dàn Hợp Xướng Thần Phạt

Dáng vẻ của kẻ chinh phục trời cao, sau khi bị Thủy Triều Đen bao trùm. Công hay tội trong quá khứ có lẽ khó mà bình luận được, nhưng lúc này chỉ là một ngọn lửa hủy diệt, tràn ngập sát ý và phá hoại mọi thứ.
target: The image of the conqueror who once ruled the skies with absolute might, now consumed by the black tide. The rights and wrongs of their past may be difficult to judge, but at this moment, all that remains is a formless blaze of karmic destruction, seething with murderous intent.

source: Dämmerungstrupp
Dämmerungstrupp: Azurschwinge
Dämmerungstrupp: Cinderborne
Dämmerungstrupp: Dämmerlanze
Dämmerungstrupp: Flammenweber
Dämonenschwein
Démon corrodé de la Marée noire
Détrapunk karmique
Düsterklauen-Wolfskrieger
Dư âm ký ức của một người nào đó về người thân. Trong đêm dài đằng đẵng, chúng đã, đang và sẽ mãi ở cùng anh ấy.
target: The echoes of the memories someone once held of their beloved family. Across the long night, they will accompany him in the past, present, and future.

source: Dưới ảnh hưởng của "Trăng Máu", Feixiao, người có thể ra lệnh cho những con quái thú, giống như một vị thần, mỗi cử chỉ hành động đều tỏa ra sức mạnh đáng sợ.
target: Under the influence of Crimson Moon, Feixiao commands the giant beast like a goddess, emanating terrifying power with her every move.

source: Dị Thể sinh ra từ trường Họa Sư, bắt nguồn từ tin đồn về "cây bút tự động vẽ". Hội tụ sự tự ti của các Họa Sư bất tài, sự sợ hãi về việc đến trường, và sự lười biếng của con người... cuối cùng đã biến thành bộ dạng hiện tại này.
target: An aberration born in an art school, originating from the rumor of "brushes that move and paint on their own." It drew together the self-pity of talentless artists, their fear of attending school, and humanity's inherent laziness... ultimately becoming what it is today.

source: Dị Thể sinh ra từ trường Họa Sư, bắt nguồn từ tin đồn về "cây bút tự động vẽ". Hội tụ sự tự ti của các Họa Sư bất tài, sự sợ hãi về việc đến trường, và sự lười biếng của con người... cuối cùng đã biến thành bộ dạng hiện tại này.
target: The aberration born in the art school originated from the rumor of "brushes moving and painting on their own." It congregated the self-loathing of talentless artists, their fear of school, and humanity's inherent laziness... and ultimately became what it is today.
