source: Klaster superkomputer yang menginjak-injak prinsip-prinsip matematika telah mengguncang dasar-dasar dunia digital, menaklukkan banyak kerajaan yang kuat. Dalam simulasi, klaster tersebut berwujud sebagai televisi, sehingga bahkan mekanik yang tidak terlatih pun dapat menguasai prosedur pengoperasian senjata perang dalam waktu singkat.
target: The supercomputer cluster that trampled mathematical principles, gaining control over countless powerful kingdoms by shaking the very foundations of the digital world's existence. They are materialized into the form of televisions during extrapolation. Even an untrained mechanic can master the control workflow of the war gear in a short period of time.

source: Klaue der inneren Bestie, Himmelszerfetzer, Irdische Schnitte.
target: Claw of the Inner Beast, shredder of heavenly planes, sunderer of earthly latitudes.

source: Klaue der inneren Bestie, Himmelszerfetzer, Irdische Schnitte.
target: Claw of the Inner Beast, shredder of heavenly planes, sunderers of earthly latitudes.

source: Komödiologe

Kontestan Shuojin memiliki banyak gelar kehormatan — Master seni bela diri kuno Xianzhou, top 100 master lokal di Luofu, top 10 di kejuaraan Kelas Bulu Exalting Sanctum, pelatih khusus Tiger Boxing Gym ... Intinya, ilmu bela diri dia mungkin bukan yang terbaik, tapi dia pasti salah satu kontestan dengan gelar terbanyak.
target: Contestant Shuojin has many honors — Xianzhou ancient martial art master, Luofu's top-hundred local masters, top-10 featherweights of the Exalting Sanctum Martial Arts Cup, Tiger Boxing Gym's special coach... Anyway, though his martial arts may not be the best, he definitely has the most titles out of everyone.

source: Kraftleihe-Kugel

Kristallisierte Elemente, die nur über wenig Intelligenz verfügen. Sie ziehen in Gestalt von Vögeln, die eine starke Hitzestrahlung abgeben und alles verbrennen, was ihnen in die Quere kommt, durch das Fragmentum.
target: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird emitting intense heat, burning everything in its path.

source: Kristallisierte Elemente, die nur über wenig Intelligenz verfügen. Sie ziehen in Gestalt von Vögeln, die für schaurig niedrige Temperaturen sorgen und alles in ihrer Nähe einfrieren lassen, durch das Fragmentum.
target: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird releasing eerily low temperatures, freezing everything around it.

source: Kristallisierte Elemente, die nur über wenig Intelligenz verfügen. Sie ziehen in Gestalt von Vögeln, die von einem starken Wind umgeben werden und alles um sie herum wie ein Tornado verwüsten, durch das Fragmentum.
target: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird engulfed in twisting winds, raging on like a tornado.

source: Kristallisierte Elemente, die nur über wenig Intelligenz verfügen. Sie ziehen in Gestalt von Vögeln, die vor Elektrizität strotzen und in alle Richtungen Donnerschläge freisetzen, durch das Fragmentum.
target: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird brimming with electricity, releasing thunderclaps in all directions.

source: Kích động tâm ma, chiếm đoạt tinh thần, biến đổi ngoại hình, Tà Vật ẩn nấp trong cơ thể Feixiao bắt đầu cuộc săn đuổi cô. Cuối cuộc săn đuổi này, bên còn sống sót sẽ dùng thân phận Tướng Quân Thiên Kích để bước đi trên thế gian.
target: Provoking the temptations within, usurping the powerful spirit, transforming in appearance... The abomination lurking inside Feixiao has begun its hunt for her. At the end of this stalking pursuit, the surviving party would obtain the right to walk the world as the Merlin's Claw.

source: Körper, die nach ihrem Tod weiter durch das Fragmentum zersetzt wurden. Ihre Lebenszeichen mögen sich geändert haben, doch sie befolgen weiterhin ihren Befehl, Gegner zu eliminieren. Leeren-Ranger: Eliminatoren markieren getroffene Gegner, wodurch diese bei Angriffen zusätzlichen Schaden erleiden.
target: Bodies that continued to be corroded by the Fragmentum after death. While their vital signs have changed, they continue to carry out their orders to eliminate. Voidranger: Eliminators will mark enemies they hit, causing them to take extra damage when attacked.

source: Ký hiệu cuối cùng được hội tụ bởi sinh mệnh vỡ vụn, linh hồn ở bờ bên kia vẫn mong ngóng về bên này, bia đá của lãng quên và ly biệt phản chiếu trong ánh mắt. Linh hồn vô tội ngủ vùi trong Bia Mộ Vĩnh Hằng, tiêu diệt Bia Mộ Vĩnh Hằng có thể đánh thức họ.
target: Shattered existences serve as symbols of ultimate closure. Across the ethereal expanse, spirits cast their gaze upon the mortal realm, their eyes reflecting the etchings of oblivion and separation. Innocent souls slumber within the Sombrous Sepulcher. Defeat the Tomb to awaken them.

source: Ký ức và ảnh chụp rất giống nhau, trông có vẻ như ghi lại "sự thật", nhưng nó lại như đang xâm phạm "sự thật", bóp méo "sự thật", xáo trộn "sự thật". Có lẽ xóa bỏ phần không chân thật trong đó sẽ giúp nó đáng tin hơn, hoặc không.
target: "Memory" is similar to "photographs." Even though it appears to record "reality," it actually invades, alienates, and alters "reality." Perhaps removing the "distortion" will make it reliable, or perhaps not.

source: Ký ức về "Phân Tranh" luôn đi kèm với sự bất khuất và đấu tranh.
target: Memories of Strife are always accompanied by defiance and resistance.

target: Those driven mad by the sea siren's song lose their sanity the moment they leap into the ocean, becoming the sirens' pawns.

source: Kẻ xâm nhập nham hiểm, lấy danh nghĩa loại bỏ chuyển thế của Dan Feng để ám sát Dan Heng.
target: A malevolent intruder. Seeks to assassinate Dan Heng in order to eliminate the reincarnation of Dan Feng.

source: Kẻ Địch Dị Tướng
Kỵ Sĩ Bạc Cao Thượng
Kỵ Sĩ Đỏ
Kỵ sĩ cổ điển của Đội Kỵ Sĩ Đẹp Thuần Khiết, thành kính tín ngưỡng Aeon "Đẹp Thuần Khiết" Idrila đã mất tích. Ngay thẳng chính trực, chu du khắp vũ trụ, ca ngợi vẻ đẹp của Idrila.
target: A paragon knight of the Knights of Beauty who is piously seeking his missing Aeon, Idrila the Beauty. Forthright and candid, he wanders the cosmos espousing the virtues of Idrila's good name.

source: Kỵ sĩ cổ điển của Đội Kỵ Sĩ Đẹp Thuần Khiết, thành kính tôn thờ Aeon "Đẹp Thuần Khiết" Idrila vốn đã mất tích từ lâu. Ngay thẳng chính trực, chu du khắp vũ trụ, ca ngợi vẻ đẹp của Idrila.
target: A paragon knight of the Knights of Beauty who is piously seeking his missing Aeon, Idrila the Beauty. Forthright and candid, he wanders the cosmos espousing the virtues of Idrila's good name.

source: L'Assassin temporel traverse le temps, récoltant sans pitié la précieuse valeur d'action des autres.
target: The Time Assassin weaves through time, ruthlessly harvesting everyone's precious action value.

source: L'Honneur
L'Invincible dévasté

L'ambassadeur divin qui assista à des centaines de millions de cycles sous le nom de Lycurgus après avoir hérité de la volonté du membre n° 1 de la Société des génies, Zandar One Kuwabara. Avec l'autorité du premier génie et fort d'un pouvoir dépassant ceux des dieux, il supervise une expérience sempiternelle pour accomplir le destin de la Destruction.
target: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member #1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

source: L'ensemble de superordinateurs qui a bafoué les principes mathématiques et pris le contrôle d'innombrables empires en ébranlant les bases de l'existence du monde numérique. En phase de calcul, ils se matérialisent sous forme de téléviseurs. Même les mécaniciens peu expérimentés se familiarisent au fonctionnement de cette machine de guerre très rapidement.
target: The supercomputer cluster that trampled mathematical principles, gaining control over countless powerful kingdoms by shaking the very foundations of the digital world's existence. They are materialized into the form of televisions during extrapolation. Even an untrained mechanic can master the control workflow of the war gear in a short period of time.

source: L'image du conquérant qui régnait autrefois sur les cieux avec une puissance absolue, désormais consumé par la Marée noire. Il est difficile de juger son passé, mais aujourd'hui, il n'en reste qu'un brasier destructeur informe et bouillonnant d'intentions meurtrières.
target: The image of the conqueror who once ruled the skies with absolute might, now consumed by the black tide. The rights and wrongs of their past may be difficult to judge, but at this moment, all that remains is a formless blaze of karmic destruction, seething with murderous intent.

source: L'incarnation ultime du pouvoir. La forme de l'énergie qui s'accumule derrière elle reste d'origine inconnue. Le Moteur d'antimatière accordera de l'énergie aux autres ennemis et améliorera leurs capacités.
target: The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown. The Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

source: L'un des clones invoqués par le Voleur de flammes à l'aide de la Puissance de la calamité. Il est animé par la destruction.
target: Each and every clone summoned by the Flame Reaver using the Calamity Power is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

source: L'écran de diffusion utilisé par Sparxie pendant son stream. Ici, vous pouvez consulter des informations importantes comme les indices de popularité, les commentaires et les dons. Touchez l'écran pour rejoindre la session interactive !
target: The output screen used by Sparxie during her live stream. You can check important information like popularity ratings, comments, and donations here. Tap the screen to join the interactive session!

source: L'écran de diffusion utilisé par Sparxie pendant son stream. Ici, vous pouvez consulter des informations importantes comme les indices de popularité, les commentaires et les dons. Touchez l'écran pour rejoindre la session interactive !
target: The output screen used by Sparxie during her live-stream. You can check important information like popularity ratings, comments, and donations here. Tap the screen to join the interactive session!

source: L'œil errant de la Divinité de la synthèse. Incapable de produire des images, il sert surtout à aider l'œil principal à polariser les conditions météorologiques.
target: Theos Synthetos's wandering monocular eye. It lacks imaging capability and primarily functions to assist the main eye in polarizing the weather.

source: La Aniquiladora del Mistral Desolador posee la autoridad divina heredada por generaciones de Guardianas Supremas, lo que le confiere el poder de comandar el hielo y la nieve para congelar a sus enemigos en combate.
target: The Annihilator of Desolation Mistral possesses the divine authority passed down through the generations of Guardians, giving her command over ice and snow to freeze her enemies in battle.

source: La Bourrasque glaciale de la désillusion a hérité de l'autorité divine transmise par les générations de Gardiens, ce qui lui confère la maîtrise de la glace pour geler ses ennemis en combat.
target: The Annihilator of Desolation Mistral possesses the divine authority passed down through the generations of Guardians, giving her command over ice and snow to freeze her enemies in battle.

source: La Devastadora Phantylia de la Legión Antimateria, creada a partir del Árbol de la Ambrosía. Un cuerpo que combina el poder de la Destrucción y de la Abundancia, un ciclo de nacimiento y muerte. También es el primer "fruto" producido por la resurrección del Árbol de la Ambrosía.
target: The body born out of the Ambrosial Arbor by Phantylia, Lord Ravager of the Antimatter Legion. This flesh possesses the powers of both Destruction and Abundance, a form that embodies the cycle of death and rebirth. It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

source: La Distinguida
La Distinguida
La Elevada
La Elevada (error)

La Gardienne de Belobog et souveraine de la Grande citadelle de Belobog. En sa qualité de Gardienne, Cocolia a hérité de pouvoirs divins, lui conférant une maîtrise absolue de la puissance de la glace afin de geler ses ennemis en combat. Cette entité est un fantôme issu de vos souvenirs.
target: The Guardian of Belobog, and the ruler of the Towering Citadel of Belobog. As the Guardian, Cocolia has inherited divine powers, giving her absolute command over the ice to freeze her enemies in battle. This entity is a phantom borne from your memories.

source: La Lance
La Lance

La Legión Antimateria aprovechó la Fragua Bélica para fusionar los restos de guerreros con los del Leviatán. No son muy numerosos, pero combinan la inteligencia de los guerreros con la fuerza y la agilidad de las bestias. Su siseo es capaz de invocar a un gran número de Exploradores del Vacío.
target: A product of the Antimatter Legion utilizing the Warforge to recast and fuse remnants of fallen warriors and leviathans. Though relatively rare, they possess both the intelligence of a warrior and the power and mobility of a leviathan. Its screech can summon a large number of Voidrangers.

source: La Troupe Beaux rêves, dont la raison est obscurcie par l'ombre de la Forêt ancestrale. Ils portent avec eux le virus mémoriel qui a fructifié dans la Forêt des merveilles et qui promeut avec bananafierté le bananacredo du Singe Somno-banane et les conseils bananavisés du Dr Primitif.
target: Sweet Dreams Troupe with their reason clouded by the shade of the AtaviSearch Forest. They carry with them the memetic virus borne into fruit in the Wonder Forest, banaoldly promoting the banacreed of the Slumbernana Monkey and Dr. Primitive's banadvice.

source: La bondad de Cocona

La demi-déesse qui raccommodait l'aube et le crépuscule de son sourire, tel qu'il apparaît après avoir été emporté par la Marée noire. Bien que l'éclat de la flamme divine soit devenu presque trouble, il reste encore doux... La Guérisseuse n'avait jamais imaginé devoir anéantir un ancien compagnon de route ; elle jure de dissiper les nuages sombres au fond de son cœur.
target: This is what the demigod who mended the dawn with their smile looks like after they have been enveloped by the black tide. Although the brilliance of the Coreflame has been clouded, warmth still lingers — The healer never wants to annihilate their old friend, instead vowing to disperse the gloomy clouds in the friend's heart.

source: La encarnación suprema de la esencia del poder. La energía que se acumula en él es totalmente desconocida. El Motor Antimateria proporciona energía a otros enemigos y potencia sus habilidades.
target: The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown. The Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

source: La forma definitiva del trío del Zhuming.
target: The ultimate form of the Zhuming trio.

source: La forma del mundo, el deseo de búsqueda, y el espacio infinito que les da forma. De ellos nace todo el intelecto de la inteligencia. Ya no es un títere, morirá en el funeral de la sabiduría, dejando una lápida forjada en hierro.
target: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

source: La honestidad de Cocona

La muerte dejó tras de sí un cadáver en la frontera entre la vida y la muerte, y el cuerpo se despertó una vez para resistir a su destino. El semidiós no podía soportar ver a su amigo acercarse a un final más cruel que la muerte, por lo que tuvo que extender sus brazos para detenerlo. Aunque su carne ya no estaba y solo quedaban unos huesos, su poder y determinación seguían siendo inigualables.
target: The broken body of "Death" that remains in the limbo of life and death, they woke once again to fight against fate. The demigod could not bear to witness a friend walk toward an end more cruel than Death, and thus reached out their long arm to stop the friend. Even though withered bones and rotting flesh are all they have left, their power and determination are not to be underestimated.

source: La pointe de sa lance a tracé une frontière infinie. Les personnes et les soldats dans son enceinte sont définis comme conquis ou à conquérir. Le sang des peureux deviendra de l'hydromel pour le corps divin, et les âmes des défiants marcheront vers le palais de la gloire sous la Rivière des âmes.
target: The tip of its spear has drawn a boundless border. The people and soldiers within the border are marked as conquered, or ones to be conquered. The blood of the fearful will become honey brew for the divine body, and the souls of the defiant will walk into the palace of glory under the River of Souls.

source: La projection d'Oti dans l'histoire de Penacony après qu'il eut traversé de longs siècles. Jalousie, sarcasmes, haine... tous les propos vils et les jugements impitoyables ont convergé vers ce marchand, le transformant en un Berserker qui allie lucidité et démence.
target: How Oti, who had lived through countless years, is projected in Penacony's history. Envy, mockery, hostility... all sorts of unbearable words and searing criticism gathered upon this merchant, turning him into a Berserker who possesses both rationality and insanity.

source: La punta de su lanza dibuja una frontera que no tiene límites. Los soldados y los civiles que están dentro de la frontera se marcan como conquistador o por conquistar. La sangre de los temerosos se convierte en hidromiel para el cuerpo divino, y las almas de los desafiantes entran en el palacio glorioso bajo el río Estigia.

The blood of the fearful will become honey brew for the divine body, and the souls of the defiant will walk into the palace of glory under the River of Souls.

target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Having now acquired immense power, none can stand in its way.

source: Makhluk ciptaan terdistorsi yang lahir dari gelombang hitam. Hasrat untuk membunuh menjadi satu-satunya kehendak yang tersisa dalam cangkang kosongnya. Pedang gandanya yang tajam merobek semua makhluk hidup yang menghalangi di hadapannya dalam sekejap, dan tubuhnya yang lincah bagaikan roh yang sulit ditebak, mencemar dan menyebarkan korosi di seluruh penjuru dunia.
target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Its razor-sharp blades can cleave through anything in its path, while its figure moves like a specter, spreading decay and corrosion to every corner of the world.

source: Makhluk ciptaan terdistorsi yang lahir dari gelombang hitam. Hasrat untuk membunuh menjadi satu-satunya kehendak yang tersisa dalam cangkang kosongnya. target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Its once-human form is now engulfed in filth, exuding a nauseating aura of corrosion. Wherever the Corroded Beast treads, all life is stripped away.

target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. It looks like a transportation vehicle whose purpose has long been forgotten. In combat, Automaton Hounds can provide support and restore HP to its allies.

source: Một con mắt dung hợp. Không có khả năng chụp ảnh, chức năng chính là hỗ trợ cho con mắt chính trong việc phân cực thời tiết.
target: Theos Synthetos's wandering monocular eye. It lacks imaging capability and primarily functions to assist the main eye in polarizing the weather.

source: Một câu chuyện cười địa ngục về Quân Đoàn Phản Vật Chất, ngay cả Sparxie cũng không hiểu tại sao nó lại buồn cười, nhưng vẫn có người cười.
target: A terrible joke about the Antimatter Legion. Sparxie didn't know why it was funny, but someone laughed anyway.

source: Một fan cuồng nhạc Rock 'n' Roll. Vì theo đuổi khát vọng âm nhạc mà bất chấp dấn thân vào ma đạo. Nhưng chung quy cũng chỉ là một fan hâm mộ. Ghét nhất là "những câu chuyện cười về tay Bass". Một số trang báo hạng ba dựa vào cái tạo hình của anh ấy để suy đoán "Bass mới là thực thể của anh ta", nhưng đó chỉ là tin đồn, thực tế thì Bass bị ép buộc.
target: A die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan. Hates "bassist jokes" with a passion. Some third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

source: Một người tu luyện khao khát bí truyền trù phú phục hưng cổ đại, đồng thời dẫn dắt người Xianzhou bước lên con đường thăng thiên giải thoát một lần nữa. Đến bây giờ, nguyện vọng của họ đã thành hiện thực. Được ban tặng sức mạnh của thần tích cổ xưa, dùng nó làm giáp trụ, làm vũ khí, hơn nữa còn chạm được đến bí mật trường sinh bất tử.
target: A cultivator who longs to revive the ancient mysteries of Abundance, and to guide the Xianzhou natives back on the liberating path of immortality. Now, their wish has been fulfilled. Gifted by the power of the ancient miracle and using it as both weapon and armor, they managed to touch on the secret of immortality.

source: Một sinh vật liên chiều lạc lối giữa các vì sao, tính ấm, vị ngọt, không ăn được. Phần lớn cuộc đời dành cho việc ăn uống và chạy trốn. Những nhà lữ hành vô tình gặp nó đều coi đó là một điềm lành.
target: An interdimensional creature lost in the stars. Docile in nature. Sweet in taste. Inedible. Spends most of its life feeding and fleeing. Travelers who encounter these creatures see them as good omens.

target: One of the Stellaron Hunters, a mysterious warrior donning formidable armor. The mech suit wields the power to unleash fiery onslaughts, engulfing the battlefield in flames.

source: Một tuyển thủ tin rằng mình chính là thực vật, kỹ năng tất sát là đòn tấn công tạo ra thực vật vô cùng hoa lệ.
target: A contestant who firmly believes they are a plant, with a special move that creates dazzling plant attacks.

source: Na antiga Era Creatura, Áquila, após forjar o Dispositivo do Alvorecer, colaborou com Kephale para criar as bestas lendárias que encarnam os Titãs. Hoje, as almas daquelas grandes bestas estão entregues ao caos.
target: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. Today, the souls of those great beasts are now in utter chaos.

source: Na antiga Era Creatura, Áquila, após forjar o Dispositivo do Alvorecer, colaborou com Kephale para gerar as bestas lendárias que incorporam os Titãs. Dizem que a Águia Meteórica é um símbolo das penas celestiais de Áquila que ocasionalmente caem no reino dos mortais.
target: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. It is whispered that the Meteoric Eagle is a symbol of Aquila's celestial feathers that occasionally fall to the mortal realm.

target: In the ancient Era Creatura, Aquila, after forging the Dawn Device, collaborated with Kephale to bring forth the legendary beasts embodying the Titans. The Noontide Gryphon is said to represent Aquila after opening their eyes to bestow light upon the world.

source: Nachdem die Oberste Wächterin von der überlaufenden Fragmentum-Energie des Stellarons aufgenommen wurde, verwandelte sie sich in eine „Sängerin“ und Verkünderin der vom Stellaron versprochenen „neuen Welt“, die in der Lage ist, imaginäre Energie zu kontrollieren.
target: After being assimilated by the overflowing Fragmentum energy of the Stellaron, the Supreme Guardian transforms into a chantress able to control Imaginary Energy and the mouthpiece of the Stellaron's promised "new world."

target: After being assimilated by the overflowing Fragmentum energy of the Stellaron, the Supreme Guardian transforms into a singer able to control Imaginary Energy and the mouthpiece of its promised "new world." This entity is a phantom borne from your memories.

source: Nahkampf-Magiewesen

Nascida no Fragmentum e criada pelo Stellaron, essa forma de vida alienígena se alimenta da energia deste mundo. O fogo abrasador do núcleo de uma estrela queima em sua armadura. Em combate, a Chama do Espaço Sideral incinerará qualquer coisa que tocar.
target: Born of the Fragmentum and created by the Stellaron, this alien life form feeds on this world's energy. The blazing fires from the core of a star burn on its armor. In combat, the Blaze Out of Space will incinerate anything it touches.

source: Nascido de um fragmento do Pseudo-Desperto "Asat Pramad", busca desconstruir completamente a Euforia analisando a comédia. Sua própria existência existe em prol da Destruição, tomando a tragédia como o cerne da comédia e a "Destruição" como a verdade suprema da "Euforia".
target: Born from a fragmented part of the Pseudo-Awakened One "Asat Pramad," it seeks to completely deconstruct the Elation by analyzing comedy. Its very existence exists for the sake of Destruction, taking tragedy as the core of comedy and "Destruction" as the ultimate truth of "Elation".

source: NeiKos496が長い演算の中で導き出した「憎悪」は、星海を静寂へと静める「壊滅」の糧である。この感情は完璧な殻から溢れると、至高の悪意を残して消えた。
target: Through NeiKos496's endless extrapolations, "Hatred" nourishes "the Destruction" that silences the starry sea. This emotion overflows from a flawless shell, leaving behind echoes of supreme malevolence.

source: NeiKos496在漫長演算中求得的「恨」，滋養令星海靜默的「毀滅」。這份情感自完美無缺的軀殼中流溢，留下至高惡意的殘像。
target: Through NeiKos496's endless extrapolations, "Hatred" nourishes "the Destruction" that silences the starry sea. This emotion overflows from a flawless shell, leaving behind echoes of supreme malevolence.

target: Through NeiKos496's endless extrapolations, "Hatred" nourishes "the Destruction" that silences the starry sea. This emotion overflows from a flawless shell, leaving behind echoes of supreme malevolence.

It should be performing in the Charmony Festival, but it is now bound by Order and keeps performing scenes of the "Past." The past is an immortal chain, its tranquil flame igniting within a cage, beckoning the jailer's authority with mere candlelight.

Nhạc công chịu trách nhiệm chơi giai điệu hòa âm trong Đoàn Kịch Mộng Đẹp. Lẽ ra sẽ biểu diễn trong "Đại Nhạc Hội Hòa Hợp", nay lại bị "Trật Tự" ràng buộc, phải diễn trong vở kịch về "Tương Lai". target: A musician responsible for playing the harmonious tune in the Sweet Dreams Troupe. It should be playing in the Charmony Festival, but it is now bound by Order and keeps performing scenes of the "Future." The future is an eternal ballad, a vision of happiness strung together, calling to the composing sovereign with the melody of a harp.

source: Nhị Đương Gia Tổ Chức Đồng Nguyện, Caustide
Nhị đương gia của Tổ Chức Đồng Nguyện, băng đường phố. Mặc dù đã đi vào con đường lầm lạc nhưng vẫn không quên khát vọng âm nhạc, ngay cả khi chiến đấu cũng cầm nhạc cụ trên tay vừa múa vừa hát.
target: The Underboss of the street gang, Synwish Syndicate. Though they've gone astray, their musical dreams never faded. They still sing and dance with instruments, even in combat.

source: Những chiến binh còn sống sót, trải qua quá trình tôi luyện lại của "Lò Luyện Chiến Tranh", đã nhận được sức mạnh có tên là "hủy diệt", phản vật chất bù đắp vào thân xác của họ, các hạt âm dao động trong cơ thể họ. Đơn vị tác chiến cơ bản của Quân Đoàn Phản Vật Chất, cụ thể hóa ý chí "hủy diệt", hành động theo bản năng phá hoại và có tính hiếu chiến mạnh mẽ.
target: Warriors yet to perish were recast in the Warforge and gained Destruction's power. Antimatter completes their bodies and negative particles reverberate throughout their forms. Violently aggressive, they embody the will of Destruction and are basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion, acting only according to their destructive instincts.

source: Những ghi chép sử thi, sự lãng mạn của truyền thuyết, và vô vàn năm tháng đã ban cho chúng giá trị, từ đó sinh ra linh tính của tất cả tín ngưỡng. Nó không còn là tù nhân nữa, nó sẽ chết trong tang lễ của linh tri, để lại một tấm bia mộ bằng sắt.
target: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

source: Những sinh mệnh kỳ quái không thuộc về thế giới này, trưởng thành trong Rãnh Nứt mà Stellaron mang đến, ký sinh trong cấu trúc nền tảng của thế giới để hút lấy năng lượng, lớp vỏ cứng của giáp trụ phản chiếu lại bầu trời sao ảm đạm tĩnh mịch. Trong trận, Băng Vũ Trụ có thể đóng băng kẻ địch một cách dễ dàng.
target: A strange being that does not belong to this world. Nurtured in the Fragmentum brought by the Stellaron, it feeds upon this world's root structures to obtain energy. Its armor reflects the gloomy and profound starry sky. In combat, the Ice Out of Space will freeze targets it touches.

Chúng giỏi mai phục và đấu trí, giống như lũ kền kền tham lam, luôn khao khát dâng hiến thêm những tế phẩm mới cho Thủy Triều Đen.

Specializing in ambush and strategic maneuvers, they hover like ravenous vultures, craving to deliver fresh sacrifices to the black tide.

target: At the last dawn before the end, even the bright and clear morning sun will tremble and cower away. Dawn's Left Hand is adept at drawing upon Quantum power to launch attacks at single targets.

target: A Noble Phantasm condensed from Miss Note's despair. "Do not walk on the stage. Do not chase after the starlight." Her resentment before death transforms into a monster, stripping the heroes on stage of their disguises and bringing them an ordinary, happy ending.

target: Noontide Gryphon corroded by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Even after losing Aquila's blessings, the inexhaustible energy within the black tide has turned it into something even more horrifying.

With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

source: O Titã do Céu. Theos Synthetos. Foi conquistada e fundida com a humanidade, não governa mais o ciclo do dia e da noite de Amphoreus, mas seu orgulho distante permanece inalterado. Em sua mente, os mortais comuns do mundo estilhaçado são repulsivos. Comparados a um mundo protegido pela luz, as massas humanas sem consciência parecem mais adequadas à maré negra.
target: The Sky Titan. Theos Synthetos. Conquered by and fused with humanity, they no longer govern Amphoreus' cycle of day and night, yet their aloof pride remains unchanged. In their mind, the shattered world's mundane mortals are unsightly — compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

source: O Titã do Céu. Theos Synthetos. Foi conquistado e fundido com a humanidade, não governa mais o ciclo do dia e da noite de Amphoreus, mas sua arrogância permanece inalterada. target: The Sky Titan. Theos Synthetos. Conquered by and fused with humanity, they no longer govern Amphoreus' cycle of day and night, yet their haughtiness remains unchanged. In their mind, the shattered world's mundane mortals are unsightly. Compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

source: O cluster de supercomputadores que atropelou os princípios matemáticos, ganhou controle sobre inúmeros reinos poderosos, abalando as próprias estruturas da existência do mundo digital. São materializados na forma de televisões durante a extrapolação. Até mesmo um mecânico não treinado pode dominar o fluxo de trabalho de controle do equipamento de guerra em um curto período de tempo.
target: The supercomputer cluster that trampled mathematical principles, gaining control over countless powerful kingdoms by shaking the very foundations of the digital world's existence. They are materialized into the form of televisions during extrapolation. Even an untrained mechanic can master the control workflow of the war gear in a short period of time.

source: O competidor Shuojin possui várias honras: mestre ancião de artes marciais do Xianzhou, top 100 mestres locais do Luofu, top 10 dos pesos-pena da Copa de Artes Marciais do Santuário Glorificado, treinador especial da Academia de Boxe Tigre... Enfim, mesmo que a arte marcial dele não seja a melhor, ele definitivamente possui mais títulos do que qualquer um.
target: Contestant Shuojin has many honors — Xianzhou ancient martial art master, Luofu's top-hundred local masters, top-10 featherweights of the Exalting Sanctum Martial Arts Cup, Tiger Boxing Gym's special coach... Anyway, though his martial arts may not be the best, he definitely has the most titles out of everyone.

source: O corpo nascido da Árvore Ambrosiana feito pela Phantylia, Senhora Devastadora da Legião Antimatéria. Este corpo possui tanto os poderes da Destruição quanto os da Abundância, uma forma que incorpora o ciclo da morte e do renascimento. Também é a primeira "fruta" nascida da Árvore Ambrosiana rejuvenescida.
target: The body born out of the Ambrosial Arbor by Phantylia, Lord Ravager of the Antimatter Legion. This flesh possesses the powers of both Destruction and Abundance, a form that embodies the cycle of death and rebirth. It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

source: O filhote de uma Ferroada Verdadeira. Baseado no seu estágio de crescimento, Ferroadas Verdadeiras Juvenis podem ser subdivididas em Ferroadas Juvenis e Ferroadas Menores.
target: The youngling of a True Sting. Based on their growth stage, young True Stings can be further divided into Juvenile Stings and Lesser Stings.

source: O maquinário de serviço de Penacony que saiu do controle em função da interferência emocional no Mundonírico. Originalmente um garçom do Devaneio, ainda está realizando sua tarefa de anunciar as horas depois de perder o controle, acordando os sonhadores da maneira mais cruel possível.
target: Penacony's service machinery that got out of control due to the emotional interference in the Dreamscape. Originally a waiter in The Reverie, it is still performing its duty of announcing the time after losing control, jolting dreamers awake in the most crude manner.

source: O maquinário de serviço de Penacony que saiu do controle por conta da interferência do Mundonírico. target: Penacony's service machinery that got out of control due to the emotional interference in the Dreamscape. Originally a prize-drawing robot made to bring surprise to guests, it still bears all kinds of gifts even after losing control, and longs to prove the good luck of the guest by sacrificing itself.

source: O olho monocular errante de Theos Synthetos. Não possui capacidade de imagem e funciona principalmente para ajudar o olho principal na polarização do clima.

Menyerang Silvermane Lieutenant yang memasuki status tersebut akan segera memicu serangan balasan yang kuat.
target: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is the leader of a squad of Belobog's Silvermane Guards. As long as there are remaining friendly units, Silvermane Lieutenants will persistently raise a giant shield during combat. Attacking a Silvermane Lieutenant with their shield raised will result in a fierce counterattack.

source: Proyeksi palsu yang dihasilkan oleh kode yang terkena pengaruh, wujud referensi aslinya adalah Praktisi yang mendambakan untuk menghidupkan kembali Rahasia Abundance dan membimbing Xianzhou kembali ke Jalan Suci. Kini keinginan mereka telah terpenuhi. Mereka diberkahi dengan kekuatan relik kuno, yang kemudian dijadikan sebagai senjata dan pelindung, serta berhasil menyentuh rahasia keabadian.
target: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a cultivator who longs to revive the ancient mysteries of Abundance, and to guide the Xianzhou natives back on the liberating path of immortality. Now, their wish has been fulfilled. Gifted by the power of the ancient miracle and using it as both weapon and armor, they managed to touch on the secret of immortality.

source: Proyeksi palsu yang dihasilkan oleh kode yang terkena pengaruh, wujud referensi aslinya adalah gorila setinggi gunung batu dengan kekuatan yang menakutkan. Saat "Ambrosial Arbor" berdiri di sana terakhir kali, orang-orang Xianzhou mengembangbiakkan banyak makhluk fantastis dengan teknik kuno mereka. Malefic Ape adalah salah satu binatang perang yang menyertai formasi tentara.
target: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is an ape as tall as mountainous boulders with terrifying might. When the Ambrosial Arbor still stood, the Xianzhou people bred many fantastic creatures with their esoteric techniques. Malefic Apes were one of the war beasts that walked alongside the army.

source: Proyeksi palsu yang dihasilkan oleh kode yang terkena pengaruh. Wujud referensi aslinya adalah Sebuah unit mesin yang berkeliaran di Fragmentum. Tidak diragukan lagi, unit itu adalah monster yang diciptakan dari kekuatan terdistorsi Fragmentum, bukan produk teknologi manusia. Serangan Searing Prowler (Bug) akan menyebabkan efek tambahan pada musuh yang memasuki status Burn.
target: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a machine unit prowling in the Fragmentum. Undoubtedly, this monstrosity is not a human creation, but one that was born out of the perversion of the Fragmentum. The attacks of Searing Prowler (Bug) will deal extra damage against Burned enemies.

source: Proyeksi palsu yang dihasilkan oleh kode yang terkena pengaruh. Wujud referensi aslinya adalah makhluk aneh yang bukan milik dunia ini, makhluk yang tumbuh di Fragmentum yang dibuat oleh Stellaron, bentuk kehidupan parasit ini menyerap energi dunia ini. Api dari inti bintang berkobar di kulit terluar dari armornya. Dalam pertempuran, Blaze Out of Space (Bug) akan membakar apa pun yang disentuhnya.
target: A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is an alien life form that was born out of the Fragmentum brought by a Stellaron and feeds on this world's energy. Its armor carries the flames taken from the core of a star. In combat, the Blaze Out of Space (Bug) will incinerate anything it touches.

source: Thân quyến Titan do "Phân Tranh" khắc ra, chảy trong mình dòng máu vàng của Nikador, là tạo vật lớn mạnh có thể chứa đựng linh hồn của Titan. Tiên Phong Thần Phạt sẽ hiến tế các thân quyến yếu đuối, dùng bạo hành đổi lấy sự trừng phạt của Titan.
target: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They are mighty constructs capable of housing a Titan's soul. Furiae Praetor will sacrifice their weaker kin, exchanging atrocity for divine punishments from the Titan.

source: Thân quyến Titan do "Phân Tranh" khắc ra, chảy trong mình dòng máu vàng của Nikador. Họ là những người cất tiếng hát dưới Ngọn Giáo Thần Phạt, ca vang những câu thơ ca tụng chiến sĩ và Vua Điên, dùng thần chú để triệu hồi chúc phúc của Nikador.

target: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. source: Thân quyến Titan do "Phân Tranh" khắc ra, chảy trong mình dòng máu vàng của Nikador. source: Tuan Tail yang mendaftar untuk mengikuti kompetisi dengan nama "Kobaran Api Karma". Sebenarnya tujuannya adalah untuk mengamati kondisi pemulihan Luka.
target: Mr. Tail registered for the competition under the name "Karmic Hinkypunk" to observe Luka's recovery progress.

source: Tubuh ini memiliki kekuatan "Destruction" dan "Abundance", suatu wujud yang mencakup siklus kematian dan kelahiran kembali. Tubuh ini juga merupakan "buah" pertama yang dihasilkan oleh Ambrosial Arbor setelah kebangkitannya.
target: This flesh possesses the powers of both Destruction and Abundance, a form that embodies the cycle of death and rebirth. It is also the first "fruit" borne from the rejuvenated Ambrosial Arbor.

source: Tubuh utama dari sumber kekuatan. Tidak ada yang mengetahui bentuk Energy di baliknya. Antimatter Engine akan memberikan Energy pada musuh lain serta memperkuat Kemampuan mereka.
target: The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown. The Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

source: Tubuh yang lahir dari Ambrosial Arbor oleh "Phantylia", Lord Ravager dari Antimatter Legion. source: Tubuhnya lebih kuat dari Trotter biasa, sepertinya nafsu makannya bagus.

target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Its razor-sharp blades can cleave through anything in its path, while its figure moves like a specter, spreading decay and corrosion to every corner of the world.

source: Tạo vật biến dạng sinh ra từ Thủy Triều Đen, khát khao giết chóc trở thành ý chí còn sót lại duy nhất trong cơ thể trống rỗng. Mọi nơi mà quỷ ăn mòn đi qua, tất cả hơi thở của sự sống đều bị nó cướp đoạt.
target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Its once-human form is now engulfed in filth, exuding a nauseating aura of corrosion. Wherever the Corroded Beast treads, all life is stripped away.

source: Tạo vật biến dạng sinh ra từ Thủy Triều Đen, khát khao giết chóc trở thành ý chí còn sót lại duy nhất trong cơ thể trống rỗng. Linh hồn quyết đấu sinh thời bị Thủy Triều Đen bóp méo, vung thanh kiếm lớn cao ngang vai, trong lúc lang thang vô định, tìm kiếm tất cả những mục tiêu có thể hủy hoại, đem đến nhiều entropy hơn cho sự hỗn loạn của thế giới.
target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Its dueling spirit, once fierce in life, has been twisted by the black tide. Wielding a massive greatsword as tall as its shoulders, it wanders aimlessly, seeking any target to destroy, offering yet more entropy to the chaos of the world.

source: Tạo vật biến dạng sinh ra từ Thủy Triều Đen, khát khao giết chóc trở thành ý chí còn sót lại duy nhất trong cơ thể trống rỗng. Lúc này nó có được sức mạnh to lớn, không ai có thể ngăn cản.
target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Having now acquired immense power, none can stand in its way.

target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Holding a bow imbued with a curse, it can simultaneously attack targets in multiple directions while shooting. Any living being that enters its sight is doomed to face the inescapable aim of its arrows.

source: Tạo vật biến dạng sinh ra từ Thủy Triều Đen, khát khao giết chóc trở thành ý chí còn sót lại duy nhất trong cơ thể trống rỗng. Tay cầm rìu nặng nghìn cân, dồn lực ra đòn thậm chí có thể đánh vỡ tảng đá cứng. Bất cứ sinh vật nào ngáng trước mặt nó, đều không tránh khỏi kết cục bị nghiền nát và ăn mòn.
target: A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed. Wielding a massive axe weighing a thousand pounds, its charged strike can shatter even the hardest stone. Any living being that stands in its way is doomed to be crushed and corroded.

source: Tạo vật kỳ lạ do những người bị hại bởi sự xâm thực của Rãnh Nứt ghép thành. Gương mặt đờ đẫn tuần hoàn xuất hiện, không tư duy, không biểu cảm, bộ phận từng là con người nay đã mất đi gần hết.
target: Victims of Fragmentum corrosion pieced together into one bizarre creature, their numb faces forming a sphere without thought or emotion. Any part that was once human has since vanished.

source: Tất cả những người muốn thoát khỏi sự kết thúc, đều phải đối mặt với sự truy đuổi từ cõi âm.
target: All who wish to futilely escape the Finale must face the underworld's pursuit.

source: Ujung tombaknya menandai batas yang tak berujung. Pasukan dan orang-orang di perbatasan semuanya telah ditaklukkan atau akan ditaklukkan. Darah orang-orang yang ketakutan menjadi madu yang menyehatkan tubuh dewa, dan jiwa-jiwa pemberontak memasuki istana kejayaan di bawah Sungai Jiwa.

source: Um Armamento Imagenesis pertencente à Trupe das Garotas Mágicas. Ganhou mobilidade ao carregar os belos desejos das jovens garotas. Funciona com o poder das músicas e transmite diversos feitiços de transformação.
target: An Imagenesis Armament belonging to the Magical Girl Troupe. It gained mobility by carrying the beautiful wishes of young girls. It runs on the power of song and broadcasts various transformation spells.

source: Um Engenho criado casualmente por artesãos da Comissão de Artesanato. Originalmente, era inanimado e usado para purificar o ar, mas agora tem uma "vida" breve devido a certas mutações.
target: An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate burner used for purifying the air, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.

source: Um Engenho criado casualmente por artesãos da Comissão de Artesanato. Originalmente, era um alarme inanimado, mas agora tem uma "vida" breve devido a certas mutações.
target: An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate alarm bell used for warnings, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.

source: Um Engenho criado casualmente por artesãos da Comissão de Artesanato. Originalmente, era uma lanterna inanimada usada para iluminar a escuridão, mas agora tem uma "vida" breve devido a certas mutações.
target: An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate illuminator used for casting light upon darkness, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.

source: Um Fantasma Nobre condensado do desespero da Srta. Nota. "Não caminhe no palco. Não persiga o brilho estelar." Seu ressentimento antes da morte se transforma em um monstro, despindo os heróis no palco de seus disfarces e trazendo-lhes um final comum e feliz.
target: A Noble Phantasm condensed from Miss Note's despair. "Do not walk on the stage. Do not chase after the starlight." Her resentment before death transforms into a monster, stripping the heroes on stage of their disguises and bringing them an ordinary, happy ending.

source: Um Guarda-Vazio que sobreviveu à aniquilação de partículas, e tem as partículas positivas e negativas de seu corpo estranhamente equilibradas, garantindo mais poder que furtadores comuns. Unidade de combate básica da Legião Antimatéria. Apresenta um pouco de inteligência e é capaz de controlar furtadores em uma área circundante próxima.
target: A Voidranger that has successfully survived particle annihilation, the positive and negative particles in its body have temporarily achieved a strange balance, granting them more power than ordinary reavers. Basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion. They possess some intelligence and are able to control reavers within a small surrounding area.

source: Um Imagenae bastante empregado no serviço público e em investigações criminais para auxiliar unidades de combate. O Departamento de Defesa de Aberrações produz eles em massa usando o livro "Os Casos de Baleia, a Cachorra Maravilhosa" como modelo, garantindo que todos os cachorros imagenados são leais e possuem um ódio ardente pelo mal.
target: An imagenae widely employed in public security and criminal investigations to assist combat units. The Department of Aberration Defense mass-produced them using the children's book The Casefiles of Wonder Dog Lassio as a template, ensuring that every imagenated dog is loyal and possesses a burning hatred for evil.

source: Um Mechatron de uso geral de Planarcadia. As letras "DNS" vêm das iniciais de "Desculpa, Não sei".
target: A general-purpose mechatron from Planarcadia. The letters "SD" are from the initials of "Sorry, Dunno."

source: Um Pelôncio que, por algum motivo, se veste exatamente como você, o repórter principal da "Pelolôncio Semanal", com um talento especial para tirar 10 fotos em um único segundo.
target: A furbo who dresses just like you for some reason, the ace reporter of Weekly Furbobo, with a special talent for snapping 10 photos in one second.

source: Um Poeta da Fronteira criado por Cong. Seu "Ábaco de Jade de Inspiração" coleta dados como carreiras militares, aspirações sublimes, e outros, para criar os "poemas da fronteira".
target: A Borderland Poet created by Cong. Its built-in "Inspo Jade Abacus" collects data such as military careers, lofty aspirations, and so on, to create "borderland poems."

source: Um Poeta da Métrica criado por Cong. Seu "Ábaco de Jade de Inspiração" coleta dados como formas poéticas, padrões rítmicos, e outros, para ajudar na criação de poemas métricos.
target: A Metrical Poet created by Cong. Its built-in "Inspo Jade Abacus" collects data such as poetry forms, rhythmic patterns, and so on, to aid in the creation of metrical poems.

source: Um Soldado Lupino Borisin que bebeu o sangue de Hoolay e se tornou um peão descartável por vontade própria.
target: A Borisin Wolftrooper that has imbibed Hoolay's blood and willingly became a discarded pawn.

source: Um Titâneo esculpido pelo "Conflito", infundido com o icor dourado de Nikador. São construtos poderosos capazes de abrigar a alma de um Titã. Com suas grandespadas, eles estão prontos para repelir o avanço da maré negra ou desferir contra-ataques avassaladores em tempos de guerra. O Pretor Erínio sacrificará seus semelhantes mais fracos, trocando atrocidades pelos castigos divinos do Titã.
target: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They are mighty constructs capable of housing a Titan's soul. With their greatswords, they stand ready to repel the rush of the black tide or turn their blade in a countering onslaught in times of war. Furiae Praetor will sacrifice their weaker kin, exchanging atrocity for divine punishments from the Titan.

source: Um Titâneo esculpido pelo "Conflito". Infundido com o icor dourado de Nikador. Contém "racionalidade" roubada dentro de seu corpo. O motivo por trás de sua criação não é estudar o conhecimento universal, mas sim investigar as brutais artes bélicas e as impiedosas leis da sobrevivência, propagando assim uma loucura que pretende se passar por filosofia.
target: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They contain plundered "rationality" within their vessels. The reason behind their creation is not truly toward the study of universal knowledge, but to delve deep into brutal martial tactics and the merciless laws of survival, further spreading madness masquerading as philosophy.

source: Um Titâneo esculpido pelo "Conflito". Infundido com o icor dourado de Nikador. Seu corpo robusto é o escudo do exército, e usa seu torso de pedra para atravessar os inimigos, enquanto seus poderosos membros carregam rações para o campo de batalha. target: A gunner of Belobog's Silvermane Guards, tasked with sniping at enemies. Silvermane Gunners' shots will inflict Bleed on their enemies during combat.

source: Um assassino que esconde sua presença usando a técnica do hino da nuvem. Quem o enviou é incerto.
target: An assassin who conceals their presence using the Cloudhymn technique. It is unclear by whom they are sent.

source: Um aterrorizante guardião que atravessa o cosmos. Seu corpo dourado representa riqueza, mas também simboliza a morte.
target: A terrifying gatekeeper that traverses the cosmos. Its golden body represents wealth, but also symbolizes death.

source: Um autômato montado com tecnologia do Velho Mundo. Ele foi reforçado com uma armadura resistente para avançar nos inimigos e proteger os Guardas Crinalva. Em combate, os Autômatos Ursinos invocarão Autômatos Aracnídeos e desferirão um ataque carregado poderoso.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. It has been reinforced with durable armor, so it can charge forward and protect the Silvermane Guards. In combat, Automaton Grizzlys will summon Automaton Spiders and unleash a powerful charged attack.

source: Um autômato montado com tecnologia do Velho Mundo. Este tipo raro de autômato humanoide é equipado com uma serra elétrica no braço direito, provavelmente utilizada para operações de mineração e construção. Em combate, os Autômatos Lupinos usarão a serra elétrica para infligir Sangramento e causar Dano Contínuo nos inimigos.
target: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. This rare type of humanoid automaton is equipped with a chainsaw on its right arm, presumably used for mining or construction operations. In combat, Automaton Direwolfs will use their chainsaw to Bleed enemies, dealing DoT.

source: Um canhoneiro dos Guardas Crinalva que usa um canhão de mão portátil em batalha. Durante o combate, Canhoneiros Crinalva desferirão ataques brutais em cadeia com seus aliados.
target: A cannoneer of the Silvermane Guards who wields a portable hand cannon into battle. During combat, Silvermane Cannoneers will launch brutal chain attacks with their allies.

source: Um canhoneiro dos Guardas Crinalva que usa um canhão de mão portátil em batalha. Durante o combate, Canhoneiros Crinalva desferirão ataques brutais em cadeia com seus aliados. Esta entidade é um fantasma gerado pelas suas memórias.
target: A cannoneer of the Silvermane Guards who wields a portable hand cannon into battle. During combat, Silvermane Cannoneers will launch brutal chain attacks with their allies. This entity is a phantom borne from your memories.

source: Um capanga da Corporação da Paz Interastral cujo trabalho envolve principalmente a manutenção da ordem nos locais governados pela CPI. Com um mísero salário, o único alojamento que ele pode pagar é um quarto compartilhado em uma das naves empresariais da CPI.
target: An Interastral Peace Corporation grunt worker whose job mainly involves maintaining order in locations ruled by the IPC. With a meager salary, the only lodging they can afford is a shared room on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

source: Um capanga da Corporação da Paz Interastral cujo trabalho lida principalmente com "descuidos empresariais" suspeitos. Com um mísero salário, o único alojamento que ele pode pagar é um quarto compartilhado em uma das naves empresariais da CPI.
target: An Interastral Peace Corporation grunt worker whose job mainly deals with shady "business oversights." With a meager salary, the only lodging they can afford is a shared room on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

source: Um capanga da Corporação da Paz Interastral encarregado basicamente de cuidar de "lapsos de negócio" duvidosos. Com um mísero salário, o único alojamento que ele pode pagar é um quarto compartilhado em uma das naves da CPI.
target: An Interastral Peace Corporation grunt worker whose job mainly deals with shady "business oversights." With a meager salary, the only lodging they can afford is a shared room on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

source: Um competidor que acredita fielmente ser uma planta, com um movimento especial que cria incríveis ataques florais.
target: A contestant who firmly believes they are a plant, with a special move that creates dazzling plant attacks.

source: Um coração firme que já acreditou que havia limites que não podiam ser cruzados.
target: A firm heart that once believed there were lines that could not be crossed.

source: Um coração gentil que já acreditou que todos eram bons por natureza.
target: A kind heart that once believed that everyone is good by nature.

source: Um coração gentil que já acreditou que, independentemente de quanto sofrimento houvesse neste mundo, o final sempre seria feliz.
target: A kind heart that once believed that no matter how much suffering was in this world, the ending would always be a happy one.

source: Um corvo do bando que cerca Theos Synthetos. Possui a capacidade de polarizar o clima. Deixá-los sem controle pode ser perigoso.
target: A crow from the flock surrounding Theos Synthetos. Possesses the ability to polarize the weather. Leaving them unchecked could be dangerous.

source: Um corvo do bando que cerca Theos Synthetos. Possui a capacidade de polarizar o clima. Deixá-los sem controle pode ser perigoso.
target: A crow from the flock surrounding the Theos Synthetos. Possesses the ability to polarize the weather. Leaving them unchecked could be dangerous.

source: Um cão de caça dourado que se move com graça e velocidade. Quando a Árvore Ambrosiana ainda estava de pé, o povo xianzhouita criava muitas criaturas fantásticas com técnicas esotéricas. Cães Dourados eram uma das feras de guerra que auxiliavam o exército.
target: A gilded hunting hound that moves with grace and speed. When the Ambrosial Arbor still stood, the Xianzhou people bred many fantastic creatures with esoteric techniques. Golden Hounds were one of the war beasts that walked alongside the army.

source: Um dado de jogo metamorfoseado de "Jogador de Dados Ousado", que vai decidir o destino dos apostadores na Aposta.
target: A game die metamorphosed from "Daring Diceroller," which shall decide the gamblers' destiny in the Gamble.

source: Um dado de jogo metamorfoseado do "Aventurine dos Estratagemas", que vai decidir o destino dos apostadores na Aposta.
target: A game die metamorphosed from the "Aventurine of Stratagems," which shall decide the gamblers' destiny in the Gamble.

source: Um die Kollision und Vernichtung der Antiteilchen zu verhindern, hat die Antimaterie-Legion zwei Arten von Ionenfallen für den Transport gebaut, die als Baryonen und Antibaryonen bezeichnet werden. Antibaryonen verfügen über eine gewisse Grundintelligenz. Sie können beschworen werden und befolgen auf dem Schlachtfeld die Anweisungen der Leeren-Ranger, um ihnen den Weg freizuräumen.
target: In order to prevent antiparticles from dissipating and annihilating normal matter, the Antimatter Legion created two types of miniature ion traps for transportation, collectively referred to as Baryons and Antibaryons. Antibaryons have basic intelligence, and can clear the path according to the commands and summons of Voidrangers on the battlefield.

source: Um die Kollision und Vernichtung der Antiteilchen zu verhindern, hat die Antimaterie-Legion zwei Arten von Ionenfallen für den Transport gebaut, die als Baryonen und Antibaryonen bezeichnet werden. Baryonen verfügen über eine gewisse Grundintelligenz. Sie können beschworen werden und befolgen auf dem Schlachtfeld die Anweisungen der Leeren-Ranger, um ihnen den Weg freizuräumen.
target: In order to prevent antiparticles from dissipating and annihilating normal matter, the Antimatter Legion created two types of miniature ion traps for transportation, collectively referred to as Baryons and Antibaryons. Baryons have basic intelligence, and can clear the path according to the commands and summons of Voidrangers on the battlefield.

source: Um dos Caçadores de Stellaron, um guerreiro misterioso usando uma armadura formidável. A armadura mecha possui o poder de desencadear investidas poderosas, cobrindo o campo de batalha em chamas.
target: One of the Stellaron Hunters, a mysterious warrior donning formidable armor. The mech suit wields the power to unleash fiery onslaughts, engulfing the battlefield in flames.

source: Um eine einprägsame persönliche Marke zu schaffen, hat er nicht gezögert, einen scherzhaften Namen zu verwenden. Aber sein Schild ist tatsächlich ziemlich groß.
target: To create a memorable personal brand, he did not hesitate to use a wordplay. But to be fair, his shield is really quite large.

source: Um espadachim sem nome, levado pela maré negra para caçar as Chamas Primordiais, usa uma máscara esculpida com a expressão estoica de um Portador... No entanto, seu corpo se desfaz como lenha sendo consumida em brasa. Das chamas ecoa o vazio: tudo é futilidade.
target: A nameless swordsman, borne by the black tide to hunt Coreflames, wears a mask carved with the stoic visage of a deliverer... Yet his form crumbles like dying kindling. From the flames echoes hollowness: All is futility.

source: Um espírito vingativo inspirado no Relogin. Várias crianças azaradas foram arrastadas ao teatro pelos pais, que acharam que era um filme do Relogin. Seu enredo distorcido virou um trauma de infância para muitos.
target: A vengeful spirit modeled after Clockie. Tons of unlucky kids were dragged to the theater by their parents, who mistook it for a Clockie movie. Its twisted plot became a childhood trauma for many.

source: Um fragmento do grande Heliobus, Ignamar. Colete os diversos fragmentos do Heliobus para recriar o espírito de Ignamar.
target: A fragment of the great heliobus, Ignamar. Gather the numerous fragments of the heliobus to recreate Ignamar's spirit.

source: Um funcionário sênior da Corporação da Paz Interastral com ranque mínimo de líder da equipe de projeto. O robô que ele dirige pertence à CPI. Caso o robô seja danificado, os custos de reparo precisam ser pagos de seu próprio bolso. Com um salário relativamente decente, ele pode ao menos pagar o aluguel de um apartamento de um quarto em uma das naves da CPI.
target: An Interastral Peace Corporation senior staff member with a minimal rank of project team leader. The mech they drive belongs to the IPC. If damaged, its repair fees have to be paid out-of-pocket. With a half-decent salary, they can at least afford to rent a one-bedroom apartment on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

source: Um fã fervoroso de rock. Em busca de seus sonhos musicais, ele se aventurou por um caminho sombrio. Mas, no fim das contas, continua sendo apenas um fã. Detesta piadas sobre baixistas com todas as forças. Alguns veículos de mídia de terceira categoria especularam que "o baixo é sua verdadeira forma" baseado em seu design, mas isso é puro boato... na verdade, o baixo está sendo coagido.
target: A die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan. Hates "bassist jokes" with a passion. Some third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

source: Um galho da Árvore Ambrosiana criada pela pegada do Cervo de Ébano. Esta entidade é um fantasma advindo das suas memórias.
target: A branch of Ambrosial Arbor created from the Ebon Deer's footprint. This entity is a phantom borne from your memories.

source: Um garçom responsável por entreter os convidados na Trupe dos Sonhos Doces. Ele deveria estar servindo no Festival Carismonia, mas agora ele está vinculado à Ordem e continua apresentando cenas do "Presente". O presente é uma folia que dura a noite toda, onde o anseio pela alegria rodopia em cálices e o mais fino vinho é oferecido ao mestre que preparou o banquete.
target: A waiter responsible for entertaining the guests in the Sweet Dreams Troupe. It should be serving in the Charmony Festival, but it is now bound by Order and keeps performing scenes of the "Present." The present is a feast lasting through the night, desire for joy rippling in each cup, offering fine brews to the host who sets the banquet.

source: Um gerente sênior do Departamento de Investimento Estratégico da CPI e um dos Dez Corações de Pedra. Usando seu Alicerce, ele obteve uma parcela da autoridade de um Emanador da Preservação. Ele atira seu próprio corpo no jogo como um dado, pronto para encarar a morte com o intuito de sair com vida.
target: A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

source: Um guerreiro do Zhuming.

Um guerreiro sombrio que acompanha os Juízes da Comissão dos Dez Senhores e executa missões. Adornado com a máscara preta e branca que simboliza o emissário do submundo, ele empunha uma lâmina de guilhotina cujos golpes ecoam o dever penoso e implacável da Comissão dos Dez Senhores.
target: A somber warrior that accompanies the Judges of the Ten-Lords Commission to execute missions. Adorned with the black and white mask that symbolizes the netherworld envoy, they wield a guillotine blade, their strikes echoing the weighty and unyielding duty of the Ten-Lords Commission.

source: Um horrível Demônio Rei que reside nas profundezas do cosmos, com o poder de esmagar a galáxia e atravessar buracos negros com um soco. Milhões de planetas foram cobertos por sua capa negra, e todo o cosmos implora por um herói que possa derrubar o reinado do Demônio Rei.
target: A horrifying Demon King that resides in the depths of the cosmos, with the power to stomp on the galaxy and punch through black holes. Millions of planets have been shrouded under his black cloak, and the entire cosmos pleads for a hero who can overthrow the Demon King's reign.

source: Um humano infectado pela "Beatitude Inversa: Arquilótus Amaldesejada". Além de ondas intermináveis de alegria, permanecem impassíveis diante das seis emoções e imaculados pelos seis desejos.
target: A human infected by the Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus. Apart from endless surges of joy, they remain unmoved by the six emotions and untainted by the six desires.

source: Um intruso maléfico. Ele quer assassinar Dan Heng para eliminar a reencarnação de Dan Feng.
target: A malevolent intruder. Seeks to assassinate Dan Heng in order to eliminate the reincarnation of Dan Feng.

source: Um lobo cercado de névoa, seus movimentos são evasivos e inesperados. Quando a Árvore Ambrosiana ainda estava de pé, o povo Xianzhouita criava muitas criaturas fantásticas com técnicas esotéricas. Lupinos de Madeira eram uma das feras de guerra que auxiliavam o exército.
target: A wolf surrounded with haze, its movement is elusive and unexpected. When the Ambrosial Arbor still stood, the Xianzhou people bred many fantastic creatures with esoteric techniques. Wooden Lupuses were one of the war beasts that walked alongside the army.

source: Um líder dos Borisins que cometeu os Dez Pecados Imperdoáveis, aprisionado eternamente nas profundezas da Prisão dos Grilhões. Suportando o ódio de sete séculos de um amargo confinamento, o Senhor dos Lobos desafia o Luofu do Xianzhou inteiro após se libertar de sua cela. No entanto, parece haver outro objetivo oculto por trás de suas ações enlouquecidas...
target: A borisin leader who committed the Ten Unpardonable Sins, eternally imprisoned at the bottom of The Shackling Prison. Bearing the hatred of seven centuries of bitter confinement, the Lord of Wolves challenges the entire Xianzhou Luofu upon breaking free from his cage. Yet, there seems to be another objective hidden behind his maddened actions...

source: Um membro de gangue contratado por Skott por uma taxa premium de 2 pedaços de papel de rascunho por hora do sistema.
target: A gang member hired by Skott at a premium rate of 2 pieces of draft paper per system hour.

source: Um membro sênior da equipe da Corporação da Paz Interastral com um ranque mínimo de líder de equipe de projeto. O meca que eles pilotam pertence à CPI. Se danificado, as despesas de reparo devem ser pagas do próprio bolso. Com um salário razoável, eles pelo menos podem se dar ao luxo de alugar um apartamento de um quarto em uma das naves empresariais da CPI.
target: An Interastral Peace Corporation senior staff member with a minimal rank of project team leader. The mech they drive belongs to the IPC. If damaged, its repair fees have to be paid out-of-pocket. With a half-decent salary, they can at least afford to rent a one-bedroom apartment on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

source: Um mestre espadachim sem nome que veio com a maré negra e está caçando a Chama Primordial dos Titãs. Ninguém conhece sua verdadeira identidade. Seu poder é incrível e sua habilidade com a espada é praticamente impecável. No interior de sua espada, a loucura e a obsessão se entrelaçam, tendo levado à queda o Bosque da Epifania e Aedes Elysiae.
target: A nameless swordmaster who came with the black tide and is hunting down the Titans' Coreflame. None knows their true identity. Their power is incredible, and their swordplay is nigh impeccable. Within their sword, madness and obsession entwine, once leading to the fall of the Grove of Epiphany and Aedes Elysiae.
